name: Colli Orientali del Friuli Picolit

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata e Garantita, Italy's top tier. Stricter than DOC, and given only to wines that have been DOC for at least seven years.

blurb.text: A white wine DOCG in the province of Udine, in Friuli-Venezia Giulia, covering communes such as Buttrio, Cividale del Friuli and Corno di Rosazzo. Its wine is made mostly from Picolit, and from Picolit alone in the Cialla subzone.
